audit_items.proof_trace: `borrow_flash_loan` delegates exclusively to `flash_loan_withdraw` (L318-324), which only executes `underlying_balance.split(amount)` — no write to `self.cash` or `self.debt` on any code path. The temporary divergence between `self.cash` (unchanged) and `underlying_balance` (reduced) is intentional and safe: any attempt to over-draw from `underlying_balance` during the same atomic PTB hard-aborts at Move's `Balance::split` runtime invariant, and the hot-potato `ReserveFlashLoan` forces repayment in the same transaction.
